templates.name: Edge Spectrum: ESPN Line Capture
templates.description: Snapshots ESPN's public scoreboard for NFL, NBA, MLB and NHL and appends one JSON line per game (spread, total, moneyline, scores) to <output>/<SPORT>/<day>.jsonl, labelling each pre-game capture open, midday or close for closing-line-value analysis. Append-only, no keys. Needs Node 18+ and a clone of edge-spectrum with `npm ci` run in site/.

templates.name: Edge Spectrum: Daily Line Movement Digest
templates.description: Reads yesterday's captures from the ESPN Line Capture archive and writes a markdown digest to <archive>/digests/<day>.md: each game's opening and closing spread, total and home moneyline, the final score, the biggest spread moves, and any game missing an opening or closing capture. Read-only over the archive, no keys, no network. Fails when the day has no capture file at all, which means the capture task did not run. Needs the line capture template running, Node 18+ and a clone of edge-spectrum with `npm ci` run in site/.

packs.name: Edge Spectrum: Line Archive
packs.description: Forward capture of public ESPN lines into an append-only archive, for closing-line-value analysis, and a daily digest of how each line moved.
